name: gymcore
description: Sistema de gestión integral para gimnasios con arquitectura de microservicios

scripts.clean:dist: pnpm -r exec powershell -Command "if (Test-Path dist) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force dist }"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "pnpm dev:gateway" "pnpm dev:auth" "pnpm dev:gyms" "pnpm dev:inventory" "pnpm dev:notifications" "pnpm dev:payments" "pnpm dev:analytics" "pnpm dev:biometric"
